summary.name: Koyfin
summary.one_liner: Koyfin is an online investment research and portfolio platform for advisors and investors, offering market data, customizable dashboards, charting, and client-ready reports.
use_cases: screen global securities by filter criteria
build custom market dashboards and watchlists
summary.what_it_does: Koyfin is a web-based investment platform for advisors and individual investors to research markets and analyze portfolios. It provides live market data covering equities, ETFs, mutual funds, forex and bonds. Users can build customizable dashboards, watchlists, and graphs, and drag tickers into their workspace. The Equity Screener scans over 100K global securities using 5,900+ filter criteria. Macro Dashboards bundle market models into views, and the platform includes combined news and analyst-related content.
notable: Equity Screener with 5,900+ filters across 100K+ global securities
Macro Dashboards with bundled market models
caveats: Price plans exist for different user sizes; specific prices are not stated on this page
Only the web platform is named on this page; no native apps are described
